complicacoes.texto: The Atom’s drive toward a scientific understanding of the universe has been the cornerstone of his success, both as a super hero and a scientist.
Despite great loss and betrayal in his past, the Atom remains empathetic to both those who have known similar Dor and those who cause it.

The Atom enjoys sharing his knowledge and his joy of scientific discovery with his fellow heroes, and with younger heroes in particular. PERSONALITY Ryan Choi is a scientist whose perpetual curiosity and desire to learn serves him well as a super hero. Choi is also a physics professor and prone to pontification on any scientific matter. Powers & Abilities Ryan can use his bio-belt to precisely control his size and weight, ranging from normal size down to the sub-atomic. Ryan uses these Powers to travel to microscopic worlds and traverse long distances via phone transmissions. Like Ray Palmer, Choi usually shrinks to a height of six inches (Encolhimento 14) and has a +7 bonus to his active Defenses. As he gets smaller, he becomes even harder to hit with any - thing other than Perception À Distância or área effects (which is a good thing, as he suffers proportionately greater Dano from direct attacks). Attackers can make use of the Preciso attack maneuver ( Hero’s Handbook, Chapter 8 ) to get a better chance of hitting a foe like the Atom, with the Preciso Attack advantage making the maneuver even more effective.
